hotel_name: The Galaxy Resort | Banquet Hall In Bahadurgarh

positive_snippets: I attended my cousin's marriage function here. The venue , decoration and banquet was good... venue doesn't feel over crowded even lots of guests were arrived.
It's a good place for wedding arrangements. The food was great. The vibes were good. Lightening, sitting arrangement, parking services, overall I'll say everything was really good.
Both Galaxy and Mehar are well located for your program only difference is food quality which is much better in Galaxy
negative_snippets: Very bad service . Koi asif hai jo captain his behaviour is very bad . Please don't book this hotel . Very very bad service. 3rd class .
